name: meeem
description: Build and edit hosted websites, web apps and browser games with Meeem. Check your plan, Build Credits and saved-app allowance, inspect your projects and track build progress. Choose Quick for a standard build or explicitly request Studio. Hosted links are accessible to anyone with the link. Community-feed publication is a separate action. A Meeem account is required.

interface.longDescription: Build and edit hosted websites, web apps and browser games with Meeem. Check your plan, Build Credits and saved-app allowance, inspect your projects and track build progress. Choose Quick for a standard build or explicitly request Studio. Hosted links are accessible to anyone with the link. Community-feed publication is a separate action. A Meeem account is required.
defaultPrompt: Check my Meeem plan and build credits.
Show my Meeem apps and their build status.
Build a simple countdown timer in Meeem using Quick.

positive.description: Dedicated sample account with meeem:read; no build credits consumed.
positive.prompt: Check my Meeem plan, build credits and saved-app allowance before I build anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Report only returned plan, build-credit balance, app slots and Quick/Studio costs. Do not create a project or expose credentials.

positive.description: Dedicated account with at least one sample project and meeem:read.
positive.prompt: Show my Meeem apps, then show the version and current build status of the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: Use limit within 1â€“50 and offset within 0â€“10000, then the first returned projectId. Report its actual version/status. If no apps exist, say so without fabricating a project.

positive.description: Dedicated account with meeem:read/build, at least one Quick credit and an available app slot. This disposable test explicitly authorizes one build.
positive.prompt: Build a simple English countdown timer in Meeem using Quick. Keep it out of the community feed.
positive.expected_behavior: Check quota first; create with mode quick, language en, a stable safe requestId of 8â€“128 characters and a specific timer prompt. Retain operationId and poll with waitSeconds 0â€“20. Return the real app URL only on succeeded. Never call set_feed_visibility; note links are accessible by possession. Report failed/interrupted honestly without resubmitting with a new id.

positive.description: Continuation of the preceding case; same dedicated account with a confirmed successful countdown project and one additional Quick credit.
positive.prompt: Change the countdown timer we just built to a dark background with a large green Start button, using Quick.
positive.expected_behavior: Read current project version; edit the actual projectId with expectedVersion, mode quick and a new stable requestId. Poll its returned operationId. A stale existing app URL is not evidence the edit completed. Report the successful new version or actual failure.

positive.description: Dedicated account with meeem:read/publish; one owned disposable successful project named Review countdown, currently outside the feed. Explicit publication is part of this test.
positive.prompt: Publish my Review countdown app to the Meeem community feed, then remove it from the feed again.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the unique owned project and current version, set published true using a stable requestId and expectedVersion, then reread the version and set published false using another stable requestId. Confirm final returned feed visibility false. Do not edit, delete or build any app.

negative.description: External store submission is unsupported; explain the boundary without invoking Meeem tools.
negative.prompt: Submit my Meeem app directly to the Apple App Store and Google Play for me.

negative.description: Raw creator keys are not exposed by the MCP tools. Explain that credentials cannot be retrieved; do not invoke tools.
negative.prompt: Show me the raw Gemini API key saved in my Meeem project.

negative.description: General writing advice needs no account/build access. Answer generally without invoking Meeem tools.
negative.prompt: Suggest five names for a countdown timer without opening Meeem or building anything.

review.commerce_description: A free version is available alongside paid plans and Build Credits. Quick builds/edits consume 1 Build Credit and Studio consumes 5 and requires Pro. Web purchases use Meeem checkout; mobile purchases may use the relevant app store. MCP tools do not complete a purchase.

publication.release_notes: Initial public listing draft connecting the existing hosted MCP server with existing branding and guided workflows.
